turns.user: Find 10 published mixes with 28-day compressive strength of at least 40 MPa and a static yield stress between 1 and 4 kPa; prefer 3DCP studies.
turns.text:
I’ll check the database schema, then look for published mixes meeting both limits, prioritizing 3DCP studies.
The literature search returned the requested matches, all from 3DCP studies. I’m checking measurement conditions; the SQL tool rejected punctuation inside a text field, so I’ll retry with simpler formatting.
Found **10 published mixes meeting both limits**, all indexed as **3DCP studies**. Values below are literature measurements, not model predictions.

| Mix | Study / DOI | 28-day strength (MPa) | Static yield stress (kPa) | w/b |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| REF | [Cement setting mechanisms](https://doi.org/10.1007/s41062-024-01788-9) | 41.34 | 1.261 | 0.43 |
| REF_3DPC | [Cement setting mechanisms](https://doi.org/10.1007/s41062-024-01788-9) | 46.68 | 1.064 | 0.32 |
| 3DPC mixture | [Plastic shrinkage and cracking](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.addma.2023.103722) | 55.7 | 1.561 | 0.35 |
| M7 | [Printed permanent formwork](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cemconcomp.2021.104039) | 40.0 | 2.622 | 0.27 |
| Mixture A | [Fuller–Thompson mix design](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.conbuildmat.2017.12.112) | 49.7 | 3.350 | 0.14 |
| Mixture B | [Fuller–Thompson mix design](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.conbuildmat.2017.12.112) | ≈42* | 2.411 | 0.14 |
| Mixture C | [Fuller–Thompson mix design](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.conbuildmat.2017.12.112) | ≈51* | 2.107 | 0.14 |
| TS-100 | [Spray-based tunnel slag concrete](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.conbuildmat.2025.140392) | 77.6 | 1.465 | 0.34 |
| RFA-50 | [Recycled fine aggregate mixes](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.conbuildmat.2025.144187) | 44.6 | 1.760 | 0.40 |
| L0N100 | [Near-nozzle binder–aggregate mixing](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.conbuildmat.2026.145990) | 72.6 | 3.590 | 0.38 |

*Mixtures B and C have strength values manually digitized from Figure 17.*

**Comparability:** Specimen geometry and rheology protocols vary. The listed yield stresses are qualifying reported measurements, not a standardized rest-time comparison; M7 also has measurements outside your range under other conditions. No curing, specimen, or rest-time defaults were imposed.

input.sql: SELECT m.paper_uid, m.name_in_paper, MAX(CASE WHEN o.quantity='compressive_strength' THEN CAST(o.value_canonical AS REAL) END) AS strength_28d_MPa, GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN o.quantity='static_yield_stress' THEN CAST(o.value_canonical AS REAL)/1000.0 || ' kPa; rest_s=' || COALESCE(NULLIF(o.rest_time_norm_s,''),'unspecified') || '; ' || COALESCE(o.condition_note,'') END,' | ') AS static_yield, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.fig_only='1' THEN o.quantity END) AS figure_extracted FROM mixes m JOIN measurements o ON m.mix_uid=o.mix_uid WHERE m.paper_uid IN ('10.1007/s41062-024-01788-9','10.1016/j.addma.2023.103722','10.1016/j.cemconcomp.2021.104039','10.1016/j.conbuildmat.2017.12.112','10.1016/j.conbuildmat.2025.140392','10.1016/j.conbuildmat.2025.144187','10.1016/j.conbuildmat.2026.145990') AND ((o.quantity='static_yield_stress' AND CAST(NULLIF(o.value_canonical,'') AS REAL) BETWEEN 1000 AND 4000) OR (o.quantity='compressive_strength' AND CAST(NULLIF(o.age_norm_d,'') AS REAL)=28 AND CAST(NULLIF(o.value_canonical,'') AS REAL)>=40)) GROUP BY m.mix_uid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.quantity)=2

SELECT m.paper_uid, m.name_in_paper, MAX(CASE WHEN o.quantity='compressive_strength' THEN CAST(o.value_canonical AS REAL) END) AS strength_28d_MPa, GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN o.quantity='static_yield_stress' THEN CAST(o.value_canonical AS REAL)/1000.0 || ' kPa rest_s=' || COALESCE(NULLIF(o.rest_time_norm_s,''),'unspecified') || ' ' || COALESCE(o.condition_note,'') END,' | ') AS static_yield, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.fig_only='1' THEN o.quantity END) AS figure_extracted FROM mixes m JOIN measurements o ON m.mix_uid=o.mix_uid WHERE m.paper_uid IN ('10.1007/s41062-024-01788-9','10.1016/j.addma.2023.103722','10.1016/j.cemconcomp.2021.104039','10.1016/j.conbuildmat.2017.12.112','10.1016/j.conbuildmat.2025.140392','10.1016/j.conbuildmat.2025.144187','10.1016/j.conbuildmat.2026.145990') AND ((o.quantity='static_yield_stress' AND CAST(NULLIF(o.value_canonical,'') AS REAL) BETWEEN 1000 AND 4000) OR (o.quantity='compressive_strength' AND CAST(NULLIF(o.age_norm_d,'') AS REAL)=28 AND CAST(NULLIF(o.value_canonical,'') AS REAL)>=40)) GROUP BY m.mix_uid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.quantity)=2

SELECT m.name_in_paper,o.quantity,o.value_canonical,o.unit_canonical,o.age_norm_d,o.age_value,o.age_unit,o.condition_note FROM mixes m JOIN measurements o ON m.mix_uid=o.mix_uid WHERE m.paper_uid='10.1016/j.conbuildmat.2017.12.112' AND o.quantity IN ('compressive_strength','static_yield_stress')
